title: Githyanki Greatsword (Psionic)

sources.title: Githborn Psionic Weapon
markers: | summary = '''Githborn Psionic Weapon''' is a passive feature granted by certain Githyanki weapons when wielded by a [[githyanki]].

summary: This +1 greatsword has a 1d4 Psychic damage rider for a githyanki wielder.

fields.Weapon damage: 2d6 + 1 Slashing plus Strength modifier. +1 enchantment also improves attack rolls. Martial, heavy, two-handed, dippable.
fields.Githborn Psionic Weapon: A githyanki wielder deals an extra 1d4 Psychic damage. A wielder disguised as githyanki also qualifies if the disguise is active before equipping the weapon.
fields.Weapon actions: With proficiency, gain Pommel Strike, Lacerate and Cleave.
fields.Base value: 130 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
